product_metadata.title: Kenmore Floor Care Elite Upright Bagged Vacuum, Silver
features: BAGGED UPRIGHT VACUUM: Remove pet hair, dust and more with this multifloor, multi-surface designed vacuum for use in your home, den, or kitchen with a wide sweeper path
PET HANDIMATE: Air driven turbine spins roller brush to high RPM easily removing dander, stubborn pet hair and other debris off furniture, stairs, car and van seats and out of your vehicle
TRIPLE HEPA FILTER SYSTEM: Enhanced HEPA filter system traps 99. 97% of debris, trapping dander and dust inside the vacuum reducing allergy-induced pollutants in the room

POWERFUL CLEANING: 3D Inducer Motor combines power of 3 motors that give you 20% more air power than a conventional vacuum while never loosing suction. The Beltless Agitator reduces maintenance and repairs
3 ATTACHMENTS-EXTENDED REACH: Flexible hose and lightweight aluminum wand lengthen to reach 10'. Dusting brush, crevice tool and second bare floor tool for convenient cleaning transitions
description: The Kenmore Elite Bagged HEPA Beltless Upright Vacuum with Pet Handi-Mate provides versatile cleaning convenience. Dirt, pesky pet hair, allergen-inducing dust and dander are no match for this multipurpose all-floors design, which cleans surfaces from hardwood, laminate to pile carpet with ease. The Pet HandiMate has an air driven turbine which spins the roller brush to high RPMs, easily removing dander, stubborn pet hair and other debris off furniture, stairs, car and van seats. With the enhanced HEPA filter system, 99. 97% of debris, dander, dust particles, pollen and bacteria will be kept inside the vacuum, reducing the number of allergy-induced pollutants in the room, which is ideal for allergy sufferers and pet owners Your Kenmore vacuum is designed to tackle tasks with incredible power and ease. The 3D Inducer Motor with Kenmore's exclusive Power Flow technology combines the power of three motors that give you 20% more air power than a conventional upright vacuum motor. Combine those features with a beltless design, and even will a full bag, you will never loose suction power, performance or leave debris behind. 5-position height adjustment positions the cleaning head for optimum airflow and powerful cleaning for bare floors to plush pile carpeting and rugs, while the Reach-Out telescoping wand includes attachments that help you get places you normally couldn't reach with an upright. Accessories include: Pet Handi Mate, dust and crevice nozzle to clean hard-to-reach places, and aluminum telescoping wand. All attachments are stored onboard the unit for easy access and storage. The Infrared Dirt Sensor activates a LED that tells you where to focus cleaning power and turns off when the floor is clean. Make housework less of a hassle, by investing in this Triple HEPA pet-friendly bagged upright beltless vacuum from Kenmore.
